title: Figure 29: Monthly Distribution of Unknown-Evaluated vs. Known Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Unknown" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Unknown" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July and August have the longest bars on both sides. Caption: "FIGURE 29 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS UNKNOWN VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS UNKNOWN"; drawing A-7507.
